code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Extend diagonal runs from an endpoint when a matching color forms a diagonal pair.
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 8:
                continue
            for dr, dc in ((-1,-1),(-1,1),(1,-1),(1,1)):
                rr, cc = r-dr, c-dc
                if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == color:
                    # This cell continues a matching diagonal run; extend beyond its endpoint.
                    er, ec = r+dr, c+dc
                    if 0 <= er < h and 0 <= ec < w and grid[er][ec] == 8:
                        while 0 <= er < h and 0 <= ec < w and grid[er][ec] == 8:
                            out[er][ec] = color
                            er += dr; ec += dc
    return out
'''
